notes.title: I updated the demo version with some new factors!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=NFFQA6_HmBs;full][/previewyoutube]
I got some feedback from the previous demo version and I change some factors for more balanced skills!


[h3]Instant Dodge on normal Attack[/h3]

-A.R.M can dodge anytime when performing normal attack motion.


[h3]CounterAttack use HP[/h3]

-Counter Attack use regenerable HP.


[h3]Ultra Attack force reignition[/h3]

-After using Ultra attack, A.R.M force to reignition mode.

-Ultra Attack damage decreased.

notes.title: Hello! I'm Nevertheless Studio!
notes.content:
Hellow! I'm Nevertheless Studio!
Thank you for your interest in A.R.M!

[h2]
[list]
[*] About A.R.M
[/list]
[/h2]

 ARM is originally a simple action game made for 2-Buttons Jam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37092183/8d970d123252714c30987b130584061dfa96fdd1.png[/img]
[i]Wow, it looks like I really hated to make another screen, there are too many kinds of stuff on one screen![/i]

even on this rough game, thankfully there were many people interested in this game. so I decided to remake this with interesting and upgraded features.

New Input system, Skill upgrade, and various monsters and new playable Character.
I've done almost things want to do with this game and maybe this Game Festival Demo will be the final demo version before releasing the full game.

A.R.M is almost complete now and I plan to release in late June or early July at the latest.

once again, Thank you for your interest in A.R.M! 
Enjoy the happy Game Festival! ːsteamhappyː



if you want to know more about this new demo version, you can check this [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/arm-absolutely-reliable-machine/news/arm-development-process-and-new-demo-version-for-the-steam-game-festival]article[/url]!
